done_when: forge-next.yml splits the Windows tests into three groups instead of two, keeping the 5-minute cap; nothing else in the workflow changes

findings.body: The assertion counts matching entries but accepts any group digit. Changing the third Windows entry from `group: 3` to `group: 2` would still pass, despite leaving one third of the suite untested: `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:35` passes that number directly to pytest's `--group`. No other inspected test checks group coverage. Under the required test audit, assert that the Windows entries contain exactly `(1, 3)`, `(2, 3)`, and `(3, 3)` for `(group, groups)`.
findings.title: Not done: verify Windows runs each of the three test groups exactly once

why: Windows test group 1 keeps hitting the 5-minute job cap in .github/workflows/forge-next.yml and is cancelled without a result, so pull requests need reruns
